_doc: One row per error wording the download path must read correctly. `expect` is an ErrorClass value. `changed` is required on a row whose class or final routing differs from the pre-rebuild code (the attempt loop's order, or the end-of-ladder order); it says what changed, so the difference is read before it ships. `source` says where the wording came from.

rows.label: disk_full_errno_28
rows.source: OS wording; found 2026-11-13 migrating tests (a bare 'errno 2' match read Errno 28 as a merge failure)
rows.error: ERROR: unable to write data: [Errno 28] No space left on device
rows.changed: Was read as a merge/rename failure (manual merge, then retries). Now one honest answer: the disk is full.

rows.changed: Was unknown, and its text (with the cookie's value) could reach the person. Now: drop cookies and retry; never shown raw.
